items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: when I got to England, I heard John Handy, it knocked me right out. Completely floored me, here John Handy, because he's just, he's just, uh, absolutely genius

ctx.x: Right. Until some future time, upon your decision as to when it should be restricted. Okay, go ahead.

Well to me the whole set up in, in, in preservation hall is, uh, uh, it's a little bit, uh, a little bit confusing, a bit strange, a bit sick. This business of, uh, of having a bloke, uh, front a band which he doesn't pick and things like this, uh, just isn't, doesn't seem right to me. Uh, anyway I might threaten people's toes there. Uh, musically, I've been very impressed with a lot, and very unimpressed with a lot. Uh, cause I, I mean, I didn't, I don't think I expected everyone here to be good. I'm sure I…
No, we can restrict anything you want us to, speak your mind. Well, I mean, you know, you know what I mean, you know.
